map_note: 221,768 of the 23,450,456 mail-ballot requests in the Election Lab's data have no district, so request figures on the map add up to 23,228,688. 317,440 of the 4,605,932 ballots cast in the Election Lab's data (6.9%) have no state Assembly district and appear only in the statewide total.
